summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp filed an 8-K on July 9, 2026 to announce that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting July 13, 2026. Units not separated will continue trading under TVIVU, with shares under TVIV and warrants under TVIVW. This is a routine post-IPO administrative step allowing separate trading of components and does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic events involved.
